title: OSMO
about: Open-source tactile glove with 12 three-axis magnetic taxels on fingertips and palm, worn on the right hand; one sample whiteboard-wiping demonstration of the paper's ~140 is released.

hardware.d: Fingertips + palm; the release has the 5 fingertip taxels only · 2 magnetometers per taxel · 25 Hz
RGB + IR stereo pair · 1280×720 · logged at 25 Hz; IR masked by the authors
Wiping a whiteboard with a sponge · 8.4 s · Python pickles on Google Drive; the ~140 demonstrations are not released

notes: Paper: arXiv 2512.08920. No license is stated for the data (the repository has no LICENSE file); the colour and IR images are re-encoded and hosted here. Tactile is shown as each fingertip's differential signal (mag0 − mag1) minus rest, as arrows, rings and plots, plus all 30 raw magnetometer channels as plots.
